extra.final_summary: The data had two main issues: (1) a label variant 'Gentoo ' (with trailing space) in the 'species' column, which was normalized to 'Gentoo'; (2) two rows with impossible body mass values (4,350,000g and 5,200,000g) that were excluded. An exact duplicate row was also removed. After these fixes, the average bill length for Adelie penguins was calculated by island: Biscoe (37.53 mm), Dream (38.19 mm), and Torgersen (38.27 mm).
